title: Heinrich Böll Foundation Scholarship
duration: Funding is granted for the length of the study programme, up to a maximum of three years for master's students and five years for doctoral students.
description: Scholarship of the Heinrich Böll Foundation for international students who have completed their first degree abroad and intend to start a Master's degree in Germany, and for international PhD candidates who completed their graduate degree abroad. Applications are accepted in two rounds a year. Master's students funded by the Federal Foreign Office receive a base scholarship of EUR 992 per month plus a health insurance allowance of up to EUR 100 and optional components; PhD candidates funded by the Federal Foreign Office receive EUR 1,500 per month plus health insurance of up to EUR 200 per mon

title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship for Undergraduate Students (Embassy Recommendation)
official_source: MEXT (Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology)
duration: Five years from April 2027 to March 2032 including one year of preparatory Japanese language education; seven years for medicine, dentistry, veterinary medicine or a six-year pharmacy course; four years for grantees placed directly at a university
description: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship for students from abroad who want to study as undergraduate students at Japanese national universities, selected through the recommendation of a Japanese embassy or consulate general. Applicants first pass a First Screening (documents, written academic examinations and interview) at the diplomatic mission in their country, are recommended to MEXT, and then pass MEXT's Second Screening. The scholarship pays a monthly allowance of JPY 117,000, waives entrance examination, matriculation and tuition fees, and provides an economy-class airline ticket to Japan

title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship for Research Students (University Recommendation)
official_source: MEXT (Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology)
duration: The necessary period for the completion of the respective regular course; the guidelines note that for adopted five-year doctoral courses the first two years count as a master's course and years three to five as a doctoral course, so students must apply for extension when advancing to the third year
description: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship for students from abroad who wish to pursue research study at a Japanese university under the university-recommendation route, meaning the accepting university nominates the student to MEXT. The monthly allowance depends on the course enrolled in: JPY 117,000 for regular students in bachelor degree courses, JPY 144,000 for master's or professional degree courses and JPY 145,000 for doctoral courses, with a supplemental regional allowance of JPY 2,000 or JPY 3,000 per month in specially designated regions. title: Young Leaders Program (YLP) Students - Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship
official_source: MEXT (Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology)
description: Young Leaders Program (YLP) Students is the seventh type of the Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship. It funds a one-year master's course at a Japanese graduate school for university or college graduates with practical work experience and for young public administrators who are expected to play an active role in Asia and other countries. The scholarship pays JPY 242,000 per month, the tuition is exempted, and round-trip airfare to and from Japan is provided. title: JASSO Reservation Program for Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship for Privately-Financed International Students by Pre-arrival Admission
degree: Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, Other (junior college, college of technology 3rd year or above, specialized training college course)
program_type: Reservation programme for the MEXT Honors Scholarship, by pre-arrival admission
duration: 12 months for students enrolled in April (April of the year of enrolment to the following March); 6 months for students enrolled in September or October (October of the year of enrolment to the following March)
description: JASSO's reservation programme for the Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship for Privately-Financed International Students, for students who have already received pre-arrival admission to a Japanese institution and face financial difficulties. It pays a monthly stipend of JPY 48,000 for 12 months if the student enrols in April, or for 6 months if the student enrols in September or October. Applications are not made to JASSO directly; the applicant must apply through the school they plan to enrol in. There are three reservation categories: graduate level, EJU exam, and English courses.

title: Kyushu University International Scholarship
duration: Award-specific. Published durations include 6 or 12 months from 1 April 2027, 1-2 years, from April 2027 to the minimum term of study, and from the start of study abroad to the end of study abroad with the monthly scholarship for up to two years and eight months including the research student period.
description: Kyushu University does not operate a single named international scholarship for master's and PhD students. Instead, it publishes an annual scholarship information list in which more than 65 awards from external foundations are available to enrolled international students, each with its own stipend amount, duration, deadline and application route. Some awards are made through on-campus selection by the International Student Exchange Division and others require direct application to the foundation. title: MOFCOM Scholarship - CSC Program (Ministry of Commerce of China and China Scholarship Council Joint Program)
official_source: Ministry of Commerce of China (MOFCOM) & China Scholarship Council (CSC)
program_type: Postgraduate scholarship programme run by the Ministry of Commerce of China in two tracks - the MOFCOM-40 direct-admission track and the MOFCOM-CSC joint track operated with the China Scholarship Council
duration: Postgraduate degree programme (master's or doctoral); the notice does not publish a fixed duration.
description: The MOFCOM Scholarship is an aid programme hosted by the Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China that offers postgraduate study in China to applicants from developing countries. It runs in two tracks: the MOFCOM-40 direct-admission track of 40 MOFCOM-led projects, and the MOFCOM-CSC joint track operated with the China Scholarship Council. Through the Chinese Embassy in Sierra Leone, applicants register on the CSC portal under institution code 00010, select three target universities and majors, and email the full document set to the embassy.
